explanation.en: PASS = Pull the pin, Aim low, Squeeze the lever, Sweep side to side.
explanation.id: PASS = Pull (cabut pin), Aim (arahkan), Squeeze (tekan tuas), Sweep (sapukan).

question.en: Click the part you remove first.
question.id: Klik bagian yang dicabut pertama kali.

explanation.en: The safety pin locks the lever; it must be pulled out first.
explanation.id: Pin pengaman mengunci tuas; harus dicabut dulu.

label.en: At the top of the flames
At the base of the fire

explanation.en: Aim low, at the base of the fire.

question.en: How should you squeeze the lever?

explanation.en: Squeeze the lever slowly and evenly.

question.en: Click the part that shows if pressure is too high or too low.
question.id: Klik bagian yang menunjukkan tekanan terlalu tinggi/rendah.

explanation.en: Shows whether pressure is too high or too low. Check it during every inspection.
explanation.id: Menunjukkan apakah tekanan terlalu tinggi atau terlalu rendah. Periksa setiap inspeksi.

question.en: When is it OK to fight a fire yourself?

label.en: Others are alerted, the fire is small and contained, and you have a clear escape route
label.id: Orang lain sudah diberi tahu, api kecil dan terbatas, serta jalur keluar Anda bebas hambatan

label.en: Whenever you have an extinguisher nearby
label.id: Kapan pun ada APAR di dekat Anda

label.en: When the room is filling with smoke but you are close to the fire
label.id: Saat ruangan dipenuhi asap, tetapi Anda dekat dengan api

explanation.en: Only if all checklist answers are "yes"; otherwise alert others, leave, and call the fire department.
explanation.id: Hanya jika semua jawaban checklist "ya"; jika ragu, beri tahu orang lain, keluar, dan hubungi pemadam kebakaran.

question.en: Under Indonesian regulation, a Class C (Golongan C) fire is…
question.id: Menurut regulasi Indonesia, kebakaran Golongan C adalah…

label.en: Solid materials like wood or paper
label.id: Bahan padat seperti kayu atau kertas

explanation.en: Permenaker 04/1980 Article 2: A solids (excluding metals), B flammable liquids/gases, C live electrical installations, D metals. USFA also: Class C = electrical equipment, nonconductive extinguishing agents.
explanation.id: Permenaker 04/1980 Ps.2: A padat (bukan logam), B cair/gas mudah terbakar, C instalasi listrik bertegangan, D logam. USFA juga: Class C = peralatan listrik, agen tidak menghantarkan listrik.

question.en: In Indonesia, how often must an APAR be inspected?
question.id: Di Indonesia, berapa kali APAR wajib diperiksa?

explanation.en: Permenaker 04/1980 Article 11(1). Each fire extinguisher must be inspected twice a year, with 6- and 12-month checks.
explanation.id: Permenaker 04/1980 Ps.11(1). Setiap APAR wajib diperiksa dua kali setahun, yaitu pemeriksaan 6 dan 12 bulan.
